questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of Week 1: Assessment & Goal Selection in the 4-week launch plan?

options.text: To start taking action on your goals immediately
To evaluate your strengths, weaknesses, and schedule to choose 1-3 realistic goals
To create a detailed 90-day plan for long-term success
To celebrate early wins and adjust your action planCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: Why is breaking down goals into weekly actions during Week 2 important for high school students?

options.text: It makes goals feel less intimidating and fits progress into a busy schedule
It ensures you complete all goals within one week
It helps you avoid having a support system for accountability
It focuses only on long-term 90-day planningCorrect Answer: A

questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of tracking and adjusting in real-time during Week 3?

options.text: It allows you to set new goals every day without a plan
It helps you identify issues early and make changes before getting derailed
It focuses solely on celebrating wins without reviewing progress
It encourages skipping actions if they are too hardCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: What is the primary focus of the 90-Day Goal Achievement Plan as the final project of Chapter 8?

options.text: To review and celebrate only the past 4 weeks’ achievements
To create a short-term plan for the next week of actions
To extend the 4-week launch into a 3-month vision with monthly milestones
To focus on selecting new focus areas without specific goalsCorrect Answer: C
